0022600132.text: The Miami Heat (0-4, on a four-game losing streak and 15th in the East) visit the Atlanta Hawks (2-2, on a two-game losing streak and 7th in the East), with Miami 3 games back in the Southeast and Atlanta 1 game back in the division. Miami is without Simone Fontecchio (out, illness) and Pelle Larsson (day-to-day, ankle sprain, game-time decision), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture), and Aaron Wiggins (day-to-day, knee bruise) is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Heat won their 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 143-117 win in Miami on April 12, 2026.
